properties.name: Egyéb, belvárost övező városi területek
properties.method: Historical KSH/municipal outer and inner street circuits interpreted on the archived current OSM road network; named-road routes preferred, actual junction connectors retained; the Belváros inner circuit is excluded.
properties.approximationNote: Full source-defined surrounding inner-city unit, not an unlocated label or an action area. Historical Népköztársaság útja is resolved by explicit OSM old_name tags to Pannónia/Park streets. Current-road junction and continuation choices are inferred where the documentary circuit is not directly closed; low-confidence search area, not legal boundary.

properties.name: Perekac
properties.method: Unchanged original OSM farmyard surface containing the independently named Perekac locality; an explicit occupied-compound footprint estimate.
properties.approximationNote: The source farmyard polygon covers the Perekac occupied agricultural compound, including its mapped locality label. This is a partial locality footprint rather than a verified complete neighbourhood boundary; surrounding rural land and any outlying properties are not included.

properties.name: Fácánoskert-lakópark
properties.method: Estimated outer envelope of the explicit locally scoped OSM estate street set; convex hull of original source vertices. No point buffer, Voronoi cell or parent-quarter geometry.
properties.approximationNote: Municipal street documentation explicitly equates Császár Attila utca with Fácános kert. Eight archived OSM ways carrying the older Fácánoskert estate-road name outline the connected housing development. The outer street-vertex envelope estimates its quarter extent; plot depths and newer development phases are unresolved. Straight connections between outer street vertices are estimated search-area boundaries, not legal or cadastral lines.
